description: This is a unit test file for the AOR_Report class within the SuiteCRM project. It contains test cases verifying the behavior of the AOR_Report class methods, such as object construction, saving, loading report beans, building report HTML and charts, executing report queries, and other report-related functionalities.

classes.name: AOR_ReportTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the AOR_Report functionality, verifying object construction, report generation, query building, and other report-related operations.

methods.name: testAOR_Report
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new AOR_Report bean and verifies its class inheritance and property values.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Checks the bean_implements method with various inputs to verify behavior.

methods.name: testsave
methods.description: Tests saving an AOR_Report object with populated POST data and verifies that a record ID is assigned.

methods.name: testload_report_beans
methods.description: Ensures that load_report_beans method executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testgetReportFields
methods.description: Verifies that getReportFields returns an array.

methods.name: testbuild_report_chart
methods.description: Intended to test chart building; marked as incomplete.

methods.name: testbuild_group_report
methods.description: Verifies that build_group_report returns different HTML outputs for different parameters.

methods.name: testbuild_report_html
methods.description: Tests building report HTML with different parameters and checks for expected content inclusion.

methods.name: testGetTotalHTML
methods.description: Verifies getTotalHTML returns expected HTML containing field information.

methods.name: testcalculateTotal
methods.description: Tests calculation functions for sum, count, and average.

methods.name: testbuild_report_query
methods.description: Verifies report query string building with and without parameters.

methods.name: testbuild_report_query_select
methods.description: Checks that build_report_query_select returns an array.

methods.name: testbuild_report_query_join
methods.description: Tests different join types and expected outputs.

methods.name: testbuild_report_access_query
methods.description: Tests access query generation with and without alias.

methods.name: testbuild_report_query_where
methods.description: Verifies the WHERE clause generation of the report query.
